posts.title: Shah Rukh Khan Recalls Calling Co-Star “Beti” During a Romantic Scene: “I Started Feeling I Should Play My Age, Which Is 61 Now”
posts.description: After decades of reigning as Bollywood’s quintessential romantic icon and action star, Shah Rukh Khan is embracing a fresh chapter in his screen persona with his upcoming film, King . Speaking at the launch of the film’s second track, ‘Daddy Cool (King Version)’ , at Meta’s House of Instagram 2026 event in Mumbai, the superstar opened up about why he wanted to test whether he could still command the screen as a leading hero while playing a character closer to his real age. Holding On to the “Hero” Dream In a candid conversation with filmmaker Karan Johar at the event, Khan reflected on why playing the leading man has always been deeply personal to him since his early days in the industry: “I did King because I always felt that I always wanted to be a hero. I’ll tell you the reason, because when I joined the film industry, I felt that I was not good-looking. posts.title: Panchayat Season 5 Receives Grand Gala Premiere at IFFI 2026 Ahead of December 3 Streaming Debut
posts.description: Prime Video brought the beloved fictional village of Phulera to the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) with a special gala premiere of Panchayat Season 5. Offering festival attendees an exclusive early look ahead of its digital launch, the screening of the season’s opening episode drew an enthusiastic response from a packed auditorium. Cast, Creators, and Dignitaries Gather at IFFI The gala event brought together key creative minds, cast members, and government officials to celebrate the milestone fifth installment: Creative Team & Cast : Co-creator, co-producer, and director Deepak Kumar Mishra; co-creator and writer Chandan Kumar; producer Arunabh Kumar; TVF President Vijay Koshy; Prime Video India’s Director and Head of SVOD Content Acquisition Manish Menghani; and cast members Neena Gupta and Faizal Malik. posts.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan Joins Darasing Khurana for UNICEF’s Hindi Mental Health Podcast ‘On My Mind’
posts.description: Bollywood star and UNICEF India National Ambassador Kareena Kapoor Khan is lending her voice to youth mental health awareness through the Hindi edition of UNICEF’s global podcast, On My Mind . Set to premiere on Spotify at the end of November 2026, the two-part series features Khan introducing and concluding both episodes, which are hosted and presented by actor, philanthropist, and Commonwealth Global Youth Ambassador Darasing Khurana. Making Youth Mental Health Accessible in Hindi Developed by UNICEF alongside international experts and adapted in partnership with UNICEF India’s global team, On My Mind is designed to provide teenagers and young adults with actionable guidance on navigating emotional well-being. The Hindi edition specifically aims to break language barriers and reach wider audiences across the country.
